items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And the Asian, Japanese, Chinese, they could do that... I used to go out there and watch and look at them. I'd talk

ctx.x: You see? And some places I played up north, had more hatred for the black man than they have in the South. Yeah, and out of the cold, that's right, I want to get you that. It's the sugar beet. Mm-hmm. There was a man with a truck would go pick these people somewhere. I don't know if they went all the way to Mexico, but they were from up in that area. Because a black person probably would do it. It's too down there because they had to be doing this all day long. Oh, yeah. And the Asian, Japanese, Chinese, they…

How do you feel now, I mean, you know, like in the last few years, you've been getting a lot more recognition for your playing than you used to? You know, like, you know, one thing is, you know, like the Novak tape. I suppose going on tour with the Jaffees. I mean, how do you feel about, you know, just...
